'''Challabae Admits-No-Equal Aerial Eruptive Manufacturing Concern''' was an [[Adumar/Legends|Adumari]] corporation in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Cartann]], with the primary facility located below the surface. Its primary business was in the production of [[Missile/Legends|missiles]] and [[Torpedo/Legends|torpedoes]].<ref name="XWING">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref>
